title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.24377v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussi

translated_title: LLM辅助的多保真度贝叶斯优化：融合专家知识与数值数据
translated_abstract: 多保真度贝叶斯优化（MFBO）通过将廉价的低保真度（LF）模型与少量精确的高保真度（HF）评估相结合，并依次选择要评估的设计，从而降低工程设计成本。然而，当高保真度数据稀缺时，仅凭数值数据难以学习低保真度与高保真度模型之间的差异，尤其是当低保真度模型中被省略的物理效应依赖于设计本身时。即使数据不足，领域专家通常也清楚低保真度模型省略了哪些物理效应，以及在何种条件下这些效应会增强。现有多保真度模型无法直接利用这类定性知识，而大型语言模型（LLM）则能够解读此类知识并据此比较不同设计。所提出的LLM辅助MFBO在传统多保真度模型基础上增加了一个知识基准：根据专家对被省略物理效应的文字描述，LLM判断两个设计中哪一个需要更大的带符号残差修正，并利用成对高斯（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出LLM辅助的多保真度贝叶斯优化方法，利用大型语言模型将专家关于低保真度模型所缺失物理效应的定性描述转化为成对比较知识，并与数值数据融合，从而在高保真度数据稀缺时更准确地学习低-高保真度差异，降低工程设计成本。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization, which leverages LLMs to convert qualitative expert descriptions of the physics omitted in low-fidelity models into pairwise comparison knowledge, fusing it with numerical data to better learn the LF-HF discrepancy when high-fidelity data are scarce and reduce engineering design costs.
